status_rules.CONFIRMED: An official source (file, section, hash) is archived under docs/official/ and cited.
status_rules.MODIFIED: An official variant exists and the exact adaptation is recorded together with a CR.
status_rules.UNRESOLVED: No official statement available; the assumption is isolated in adapter/ and configs/ and must not leak into core logic.

assumptions.title_ru: Инструменты могут называться list_records, get_record, get_document, calc, submit
assumptions.title_en: Tool names may be list_records / get_record / get_document / calc / submit
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer publishes the tool list, arguments and error semantics in writing (Q-001) and adapter profile is BOUND.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Every policy prompt, arena client and test that names a tool would be wrong; the environment would reject valid actions.

assumptions.title_ru: Могут быть четыре типа ошибок: DUPLICATE_PAYMENT, PARTIAL_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION, FX_RATE_MISMATCH, PERIOD_CUTOFF
assumptions.title_en: The anomaly taxonomy may be exactly four types
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer publishes the anomaly taxonomy and its accounting semantics (Q-004).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Generator, verifier, matcher and arena would implement the wrong taxonomy; scores would be incomparable with the official benchmark.
assumptions.notes: Taxonomy is data (spec/anomaly_catalog.json + schema enum), never a hardcoded if/elif ladder in core logic.

assumptions.title_ru: Finding может включать type, affected_ids, claimed_amount, currency, evidence_ids, explanation и optional confidence
assumptions.title_en: The finding schema may be type + affected_ids + claimed_amount + currency + evidence_ids + explanation + optional confidence
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer publishes the finding schema, ID rules and array limits (Q-003).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Policies would emit findings the official scorer cannot parse; the matcher could accept fields the official contract forbids.

assumptions.title_ru: Лимит может быть 100 действий, размер страницы — максимум 50
assumptions.title_en: Budget may be 100 inspection steps and the page size at most 50
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer publishes the environment limits and reset/step semantics (Q-002).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Truncation timing, step penalty and page-size validation would all be wrong; reward becomes incomparable.

assumptions.title_ru: Reward может быть F1 минус штраф за шаги, ETA=0.05, max_steps=100
assumptions.title_en: Reward may be F1 - ETA * steps_used / max_steps with ETA=0.05 and max_steps=100
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer publishes the reward formula, match criteria and tolerance rules (Q-005).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Every reported reward, all baseline comparisons and the arena ladder would be wrong.
assumptions.notes: The formula string is data. No module may embed 0.05 or 100 as a literal (checked by tools/check_no_magic_numbers.py).

assumptions.title_ru: submit может не входить в inspection_steps
assumptions.title_en: submit may not count as an inspection step
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer confirms the step accounting rule together with the reward formula (Q-005/Q-013).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Step penalty would be systematically off by one; budget-aware policies would be miscalibrated.

assumptions.title_ru: При truncation могут подаваться пустые findings с обычным scoring
assumptions.title_en: Truncation may submit empty findings and still be scored normally
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer confirms truncation semantics and when reward is returned (Q-013).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: A clean episode reached by truncation could show F1=1 and look like a successful audit.

assumptions.title_ru: Closed mode может скрывать reward до финализации harness
assumptions.title_en: Closed mode may hide the reward until the harness finalizes the episode
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer confirms reward visibility and scoring time (Q-013).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: The whole sealed-evaluation claim would be unsupported; a policy could hill-climb on live reward.
assumptions.notes: CLOSED_EVAL is the default in code, not only in documentation (REQ-ENV-030).

assumptions.title_ru: Cursor может быть непрозрачным и связанным со snapshot
assumptions.title_en: The cursor may be opaque and bound to the snapshot
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Pagination could leak or break replay; if the official protocol returns plain offsets, the adapter must translate.
assumptions.notes: The cursor is documented as checksum-only, not as an authenticated token (§14.5).

assumptions.title_ru: Повторный submit/вызовы после terminal могут возвращать bounded errors
assumptions.title_en: Repeated submits or post-terminal calls may return bounded errors
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer defines termination and resubmission semantics (Q-002).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: A policy could overwrite a submission or probe the scorer through error differences.

assumptions.title_ru: Может быть watchdog 60 секунд; основной лимит — детерминированные шаги
assumptions.title_en: There may be a 60 s watchdog; the primary limit is deterministic steps
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer publishes runtime restrictions including timeouts (Q-009).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: A wall-clock truncation would make runs non-deterministic and replay impossible.
assumptions.notes: Wall clock is a watchdog only; a timeout is a run error, never a quiet truncation.

assumptions.title_ru: Могут выдаваться train/dev, а hidden test храниться у организаторов
assumptions.title_en: train/dev may be published while the hidden test stays with the organizers
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer publishes the data splits and the submission contents (Q-008).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Clean/mutated twins could leak across splits and inflate held-out numbers; hidden data could be committed by accident.

assumptions.title_ru: Runtime может быть Python 3.11, offline, около 2 CPU/4 GB RAM/1 GB
assumptions.title_en: Runtime may be Python 3.11, offline, about 2 CPU / 4 GB RAM / 1 GB disk
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer publishes the runtime and resource limits (Q-009).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: A dependency outside the stdlib or a network call would fail on the judge machine.

assumptions.title_ru: Допуск может рассчитываться от количества операций округления
assumptions.title_en: The tolerance may be derived from the number of rounding operations
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer publishes the tolerance model (Q-005) or the generator proves the bound per type.
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: A too-small tolerance rejects correct answers; a too-large tolerance accepts wrong ones and hides real errors.

assumptions.title_ru: Seed не должен появляться в observation/info
assumptions.title_en: The seed must never appear in observation or info
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer confirms whether a sealed reference exists and how it is protected (Q-010).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: A policy could regenerate the whole episode and read the truth.
assumptions.notes: Enforced by a canary/leak scan in later phases plus the info allowlist.

assumptions.title_ru: Рубрика может содержать 20 проверок в каждом из 4 блоков и 5 критериев
assumptions.title_en: The rubric may contain 20 checks in each of 4 blocks plus 5 engineering criteria
assumptions.status_reason: No organizer statement has been archived in this repository (Phase 0 task 0.1).
assumptions.close_condition: Organizer publishes the official rubric and weights (Q-012).
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Effort could be spent on the wrong checks; any 'score' shown to the jury would be fabricated.
assumptions.notes: Weights are never hardcoded in core logic and are never presented as official (D-0002).
